title: NATO EDGE 2026 Comes to Izmir With 284 Technology Firms
excerpt: Türkiye's defence ministry says NATO EDGE 2026 will run on 17-19 November at the Izmir Fair Centre with 284 technology firms, 30 of them Turkish.
rank_math_title: NATO EDGE 2026 in Izmir: 284 firms to attend | Envanter Medya
rank_math_description: NATO EDGE 2026 will be held on 17-19 November at the Izmir Fair Centre. Türkiye's defence ministry says 284 technology firms, 30 of them Turkish, will attend.
